---
title: "Env.SetBool"
description: "Set a bool value by key in the Env store."
---

Set the `bool` value for `key`. `v != 0` is stored as `1` (true); `v == 0` is stored as `0` (false). Silent no-op if the pool is full (256 entries).

## Signature

```enforce
static proto native void SetBool(string key, int v);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| key | `string` | The key to write. |
| v | `int` | The value to store; any non-zero value is normalized to `1`. |

## Behavior

The store is locked. The kind is recorded as Bool. Reads via [Env.GetInt](./getint) on the same key return `0` because Bool is a separate kind — there is no Int↔Bool coercion at read time. Overwriting a key of a different kind is allowed; the kind switches.

## Edge cases

- Writing past the 256-entry cap is a silent no-op.
- The parameter is `int`, not `bool`, because the script ABI does not pass booleans as a distinct type. Pass `1` / `0`.

## Example

```enforce
Env.SetBool("enabled", 1);
```
